key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (≥20%) in FIREFLY-1 included rash (77%, Grade 3/4 12%), hair color changes (76%), fatigue (55%), viral infection (55%), vomiting (50%), headache (45%), and hemorrhage (42%, including one Grade 5 event). Hemorrhage, including intracranial hemorrhage, is a key risk — intracranial hemorrhage occurred at a rate of 11% in the target population including a Grade 5 event.
